title: Conditional Statements
goal: if/else, else-if ladder, switch aur validation logic se real decisions lena.
definition: Conditional statement condition ke true/false par control flow badalta hai: if, if-else, else-if ladder, nested if aur switch.
explain: if ke brackets me expression hota hai; 0 false hai, baaki sab true. Block me ek se zyada statements ho to braces zaroori hain.
else-if ladder top se neeche check hota hai aur pehla match jeetta hai — order matter karta hai (specific se general).
switch ek integer/char/enum value ko case labels se match karta hai. break na ho to fall-through hota hai; default unmatched ke liye.
Conditions me range check karna safe hai: 0 <= age && age <= 120. `a < b < c` C me galat hai kyunki wo (a<b)<c ban jaata hai.
analogy: Decision making traffic signal jaisa hai: agar green hai to chalo, warna red par ruko. else-if ladder ek queue hai — pehla matching gate hi khulta hai.
why: Har real program me validation, menu aur business rules hote hain. switch vs if ka sahi choice readability aur bug-free behaviour deta hai.

syntax.note: Order descending hai: pehla match hi lagega.
break missing = fall-through; default optional par recommended.

topics.title: if / if-else / nested if
topics.body: if (cond) {...} else {...}. Nested if me braces aur indentation se ambiguity door karo (dangling else nearest if se judta hai).

topics.title: else-if ladder
topics.body: Multiple exclusive conditions ke liye. Sabse specific condition pehle, warna general condition sab kha jaayegi. Har branch mutually exclusive rakho.

topics.title: switch statement
topics.body: Integral expression (int, char, enum) par chalta hai; case labels compile-time constants hone chahiye. Duplicate case error hai. break se exit; jaan-bujh kar fall-through bhi use hota hai (multiple cases ek hi code).

topics.title: Validation patterns
topics.body: Input range, non-negative, password length, menu choice — sab conditions. Invalid input par clear error do aur loop se dobara pucho (Module 7 ke saath).

mcqs.q: switch kis type par nahi chalta?
mcqs.explain: switch integral types par chalta hai; floating point allowed nahi.
break nearest switch ya loop se exit karta hai.

interview.q: if-else aur switch me kab kya?
interview.a: Discrete integral values (menu, state) ke liye switch readable hai aur compiler jump table bana sakta hai. Ranges, floats aur complex conditions ke liye if-else.
interview.followUp: switch me string? — C me nahi; if/strcmp use karo.

interview.a: Bina braces ke else nearest unmatched if se judta hai, jo expected se alag ho sakta hai. Braces se ambiguity khatam karo.
Jab multiple case labels ek hi code chalaते hain (case 3: case 4: ...). Warna break bhoolna bug hai; /* fallthrough */ comment likho.
